title: The violet flame
description: The violet flame is the transmuting fire of Lumeria. Each frame is checked on your device. Nudity, gore or an attack is blurred before you see it.
line: Checked on this device. A clear frame plays. The first offense is one month off the public forum.
alt: The violet flame over Earth: a clear frame plays, and a cover rises before you see it

title: Blurred before you see it. On this device.

title: An attack on people for who they are.

title: Human rights and creators first.
